description: Every offline input the palaeo-coastline compiler reads, pinned by size and sha256. The compiler refuses to run when any of them changes; the digests are the same values the Phase R audit recorded in docs/research/palaeo-coastlines-cao2017-audit.json.

sources.modificationStatement: EarthHistory modifications: the present-day polygons are cut by the present-day Cao et al. (2024) v2.4 static partitions, each piece is given exactly one partition owner and rides that plate, ring edges are densified on great circles, node counts are reduced by Douglas-Peucker, and the published FROMAGE/TOAGE map interval becomes a half-open (TOAGE, FROMAGE] lifecycle.
sources.title: Improving global paleogeography since the late Paleozoic using paleobiology (EarthByte GPlates 2.3 Paleogeography package)
